description: Re-run one queued post's own pipeline locally and return the result. Spawns the configured headless agent in a fresh run folder under dataDir/runs/, told in so many words never to post, publish, schedule, upload or arm anything, and to write only inside that folder. The queued manifest is not changed. Returns the run folder and the agent's output.

agent.description: Which agents.commands entry to run. Defaults to agents.default.

day.description: Narrow an id to one YYYY-MM-DD folder.

path.description: The manifest file, instead of an id.

request.description: What is wrong, in the person's own words.

wait.description: Block until the agent finishes, instead of returning a run id to poll. Only for a repair you expect to be quick.

waitSeconds.description: How long to block when wait is set. Default 120.

name: repair
